source.title: ADVO Project Sign-off - FOURLINQ DOORS AND WINDOWS

summary: The 7 July 2026 version of the FourlinQ Windows and Doors website sign-off, referencing the proposal signed 27 February 2026. It lists the accepted deliverables (custom modern UI, local SEO for 'uPVC windows Philippines', Smart Quote form with sales-team email, a ₱15,000-value AI chatbot, security, quotation system and downloadable catalogue), gives one year of free maintenance then ₱5,000 per year, and notes chatbot API usage is separately billed. Its Financial Fulfillment section states a ₱60,000 total investment and says both the 20% down payment of ₱12,000 and the ₱15,000 chatbot payment were received before development, which conflicts with the later sign-off and the 10 July addendum (₱75,000 total, ₱12,000 received, ₱63,000 due). Signature blocks are blank.

fact.claim: The sign-off is dated July 7, 2026 and covers the website development in the original proposal signed on February 27, 2026.
fact.quote: This document serves as a formal sign-off for the website development outlined in the original proposal signed on February 27, 2026.

fact.claim: The accepted deliverables include a custom modern UI, local SEO optimized for 'uPVC windows Philippines', a Smart Quote form with automated email to the sales team, enhanced security, bug-tested deployment, an order quotation system and a downloadable catalogue.
fact.quote: Implementation of local SEO, structured for Google search visibility, and optimized for "uPVC windows Philippines."

fact.claim: An AI chatbot valued at ₱15,000 with FAQ response, automated inquiry handling, lead management and knowledge base retrieval was delivered as an additional feature.
fact.quote: Integration of an AI Chatbot (₱15,000 value) equipped with FAQ response, automated inquiry handling, lead management, and knowledge base retrieval.

fact.claim: The first year of maintenance is free and subsequent years cost ₱5,000 per year, covering development, bug fixes, feature updates, hosting and domain renewal.
fact.quote: Subsequent maintenance will require a yearly fee of ₱5,000. This covers development, maintenance, bug fixes, new feature updates, server hosting, and website domain renewal.

fact.claim: AI chatbot API key usage is subject to separate terms and potential usage-based fees.
fact.quote: Note: AI Chatbot API key usage is subject to separate terms and potential fees based on usage

fact.claim: This version states the total investment as ₱60,000.00.
This version states that the 20% down payment of ₱12,000.00 and the ₱15,000.00 AI chatbot payment were both received before development, with the remaining balance payable on signing.
fact.quote: The initial 20% down payment of ₱12,000.00 along with the AI Chatbot payment of ₱15,000.00 was received prior to development. Once signed, the remaining balance will be paid off by the client, agreeing to the completion of the deliverables.

fact.claim: The ₱12,000 down payment is described as 20%, which matches a ₱60,000 website fee, not the ₱75,000 total stated in the later sign-off and addendum.
Ownership of all deliverables including source files transfers to the client on signing and receipt of final payment.
fact.quote: Upon the signing of this document and receipt of final payment, full ownership of all deliverables, including source files and codebases, transfers to the client.

fact.claim: ADVO retains portfolio rights to display the work unless the client objects in writing before signing.
fact.quote: ADVO retains the right to display the completed work in its professional portfolio and marketing materials unless the client requests otherwise in writing before this signing.

fact.claim: Work requested after acceptance that falls outside scope is a separate project that may incur additional fees.
fact.quote: Any work requested after project acceptance that falls outside the agreed scope shall be treated as a separate project and may incur additional fees.

fact.claim: Late payment of future collections, including the yearly maintenance fee and API usage charges, incurs late fee penalties.
fact.quote: delays in payment beyond the stipulated due date will result in late fee penalties.

fact.claim: The signature blocks for ADVO Web Development Services and FourlinQ Windows and Doors are blank in the Drive copy.
